1.t: When the sky is torn apart,

5.t: each soul will know what it has done and what it has left undone.

6.t: Mankind, what has lured you away from God,

7.t: your generous Lord, who created you, shaped you, proportioned you,

9.t: Yet you still take the Judgement to be a lie!

13.t: the good will live in bliss,

14.t: and the wicked will burn in the Fire.

15.t: They will enter it on the Day of Judgement

16.t: and they will find no escape.

17.t: What will explain to you what the Day of Judgement is?

18.t: Yes! What will explain to you what the Day of Judgement is?

19.t: The Day when no soul will be able to do anything for another; on that Day, command will belong to God.
